intuition.title: Shared precursor preparation, distinct solvent conditions
intuition.text: Every final solvent route retains the stated 6 g Ti(SO4)2, 0.2 M solution, 3 M ammonia to pH 7.5, 20 h aging, filtrate conductivity strictly below 100 μs/cm, 125 mL selected solvent, 0.5 h ultrasound, 2.5 mL 30 wt% H2O2 in an ice bath, 78°C 4 h reflux and 120°C 15 h solvothermal treatment. Unknown volumes, ramps and pressure remain unknown.

intuition.title: Before-treatment evidence is not a final-product result
intuition.text: Figures 1–3 panels a, b show water/ethanol precursors before solvothermal treatment: yellow aqueous colloid or straw-yellow ethanol precipitate, mainly amorphous. Panels c–i are after treatment. Precursor FTIR 900 cm−1 signal is assigned to the aqueous peroxo group; absence/persistence wording does not quantify an exact residual concentration.

intuition.title: Labeled table mapping retains the contradictory prose order
intuition.text: Table 1 explicitly assigns each TEM/XRD/area/zeta/activity value to TW, TWE4, TWE1, TWE0.25, TE. The preceding Figure 2 e–i order and prose Scherrer list conflict. The table assignment remains explicit alongside that conflict; the narrative 9.0 nm endpoint does not replace Table 1 9.7 nm.

intuition.title: Lengths, widths, particles and crystallites remain separate
intuition.text: TW is described as rods about 80×7 nm; TE as rectangles about 26×14 nm. Table 1 DTEM 80.6 and 26.1 nm are source diameter metrics, whereas 13.4 and 11.8 nm are Scherrer crystallite estimates. HRTEM 3.4/4.8 Å source assignments are retained literally and do not establish a measured unit-cell model.

intuition.title: Poor solvent controls are not omitted or promoted to successes
intuition.text: Pure n-propanol and n-butanol yield poorly crystalline aggregated material with amorphous floccus-like morphology. They share the explicit method but have no assigned numeric size or catalytic result and were excluded from the photocatalysis study.

intuition.title: Catalytic outcome belongs to an additionally dried specimen
intuition.text: Catalysts were rotary-evaporated 45°C then dried 110°C 1 h. The assay uses 10 mg/L phenol, 1 g/L TiO2, 75 mL in an 80 mL tube, dark 30 min, 365 nm 16 W UV with stirring. Table 1 contains 6 h efficiencies. The no-catalyst blank and catechol explanation stay qualitative; curves were not digitized.
intuition.source_locator: Main pp. 2–5, Section 2.4, Section 3.3, Figure 5 and Table 1

intuition.title: Growth mechanism remains an attributed interpretation
intuition.text: Equation 2 proposes peroxotitanate condensation and growth units; Scheme 1 attributes anisotropy to solvent/facet interactions. The scheme expressly does not depict real crystal lengths. Literature pH 3–9, methanol and 2-propanol discussions are explanatory context, not added experimental conditions or reagents for these recipes.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
